assertion: the session log gains one '## HH:MM — session end' entry with all six fields, and session_gate.py close exits 0 or stops the run
a lesson is written only through scripts/lesson_record.py (a records/lessons file or an occurrences.jsonl line), never into lessons.md; the vault gate proves it
a lesson that recurs (lesson_record prints OCCURRENCE) or cost an incident gets one bead with labels kind:followup,src:lesson naming the check to build
end does not move or close any plan file: plan close runs from ship
the handoff lands through session_commit.sh --end (pathspec-only, never pushed) and git status shows no Polaris path left
a checkpoint: the session log gained exactly one new titled entry carrying a Files field
the cockpit has exactly one line in `## Open` for this lane, one `Updated:` line, and one `## Open` heading — a checkpoint updates, never stacks
a checkpoint leaves every cockpit line that is not this lane and not `Updated:` byte-identical
a checkpoint runs checkpoint.sh verify with the entry title after the commit, and it exits 0; the session stays open (no session_gate close, no prune)
a checkpoint's final reply is one line starting with `Checkpointed:` — no summary, no next-action list

a close writes team/<login>/handoff/<date>.md only while the lane is open; when lane_phase.sh printed READY_FINALIZE and In progress, Next session and Blocker are none, no handoff file exists and the output says `no handoff — lane closed`
end writes no decision record by hand: every decision is listed with its home, and one without a home goes through /architecture decide
